text.en: Bring your residence card; the bank checks your period of stay and status. You may also be asked for your passport, so bring it too.

text.en: If your residence card has no photo, also show a copy of your resident record (juminhyo) or similar. If your card was issued on or after 14 June 2026, you may be asked for your passport and resident record too (example: MUFG Bank; check with your own bank; to be checked).

text.en: Some banks need an original ID document showing your current address (valid, or issued within 6 months). The My Number notification card and mobile phone receipts are not accepted (example: MUFG Bank; check with your own bank; to be checked).

text.en: Register your address first (moving-in notice). Then prepare a document showing your current address, such as a resident record or a residence card with the address. Handling differs by bank (check with your own bank; to be checked).
